Diego / Vivek — brief telemetry summary (attached CSV). Key observations:
- p95 spike concentrated on request path A (token streaming + prompt encoder) — p50 unchanged.
- GPU utilization on pool-west-2 increased from avg 68% to 94% between 08:30–09:00 PT; a subset of nodes showed memory thrashing and elevated kernel scheduling latencies.
- No recent model rollouts in the last 48h, but autoscale policies triggered an aggressive spin-up at 07:55 PT — metadata suggests a surge of short-lived connections.
- Traces show repeated KV cache misses for large conversation keys, increasing decode time.

Immediate mitigation options (pros/cons):
- Route traffic for Stellarnet to eu-central standby (~+120ms latency, eliminates the kernel contention)
- Apply temporary config to limit per-connection concurrency + enable prefix caching for their route (likely lower p95, minimal cost)
- Rollback autoscale policy change; may take 6–8 mins to rebalance.

I've attached p95-telemetry-20261101.csv and query-trace-logs.txt.
